name: Living Vital Spark
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 3.1-block radius for 11 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 1 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Heals 2.25 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 8.8 s
• Growth: up to 4 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
self_description:
